devdoc.details: Scope is deliberately narrow (see report/dogeos-tech-parts/02-deployment-architecture.md C.2/C.4):  - The guardian can PAUSE admissions instantly: while paused, `OracleFreeDollar.suggestMinter`,    `MintingHub.openPosition`, and `MintingHub.clone` revert. Transfers, minting on existing    positions, repayments, savings, challenges, and auctions are NEVER pausable.  - Unpausing and guardian rotation require enqueueing + waiting the 72h TIMELOCK. 72h is strictly    shorter than the 14-day minter application window and the 5-day position init period, so any    guardian misuse must surface within those windows while emergency recovery stays fast. The protocol contracts (token + hub) hold only the guardian's address and read `paused()`; all privileged logic lives here. If the guardian address is never set on the token, the gate is open and behavior is identical to upstream Frankencoin/OFD.

rotateGuardian().details: Callable by the current guardian (the key being rotated out executes its own handover, which is what makes the rotation reviewable on-chain before it takes effect).

devdoc.title: GuardianTimelock

pause().notice: Instantly pause new admissions. Callable only by the guardian.

rotateGuardian().notice: Execute a previously scheduled guardian rotation after the timelock elapsed.

scheduleGuardianRotation(address).notice: Propose a new guardian (e.g. Safe rotation). Takes effect only after 72h.

scheduleUnpause().notice: Start the 72h countdown after which the gate may be reopened.

unpause().notice: Reopen admissions after the 72h timelock has elapsed.

userdoc.notice: Holds the guardian key (the 3-of-5 Ops Safe) for the DogeForex admission gate.
